parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application group.

parameters.name: IsEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the event-triggered alert rule. Valid values:

- true (default)
- false

parameters.name: NamePrefix
parameters.description: The prefix in the name of the event-triggered alert rule.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-event-rule-list --name-prefix test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --group-id 73780000 --is-enable true --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeEventRuleList --region cn-hangzhou --NamePrefix test --IsEnable true --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --GroupId 73780000
